# Fábio Magalhães — Fractional Head of GTM Systems

## Who I am
Fábio Magalhães is a fractional GTM systems architect working with VP Sales, CROs, and Heads of RevOps at Series A–C B2B SaaS companies in the United Kingdom.

## What I do
I rebuild the operating system behind scale-up growth. Two engagement models:

- **FRACTIONAL**: Build the RevOps and GTM systems function from scratch for scaling companies. Typically 3–6 months, then handed over to an internal hire. For companies that don't yet have a dedicated RevOps function.
- **CONSULTING**: Work alongside existing RevOps and sales teams to sharpen pipeline visibility, forecast accuracy, and GTM execution. For companies that have the infrastructure but GTM is still messy.

## Specialisms
- Systems-of-record architecture (Salesforce, HubSpot, and connected stack)
- Bowtie model diagnostics (CR1–CR8 customer lifecycle framework)
- AI-assisted automation (lead qualification, PO extraction, deal approvals, opportunity creation)
- Forecast accuracy and pipeline visibility
- GTM data integrity and CRM hygiene
- Revenue stack integrations (Clay, Gong, BigQuery, Snowflake, n8n, MuleSoft)

## Who I work with
Series A to Series C B2B SaaS companies in the UK. Typical buyer: VP Sales, CRO, Head of RevOps, or Founder-led GTM at 20–200 employees.

## Services
1. Fractional Head of GTM Systems — ongoing retainer
2. Systems-of-Record Audit — one-time diagnostic
3. AI + GTM Systems Build — project-based
